title: December, 2003 (unprinted)
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Does Chloe come home. The strip doesn't know; the strip isn't running. It draws the bus stop anyway, for the box.

panels.composition: The Greyhound stop, December, rain. WOOD and BARNABY on the bench. No bus yet.

image.prompt: a young man and a small dog on a roadside bus-stop bench in December rain, no bus, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: The 4:10. Door. Nobody gets off at all.

image.prompt: a Greyhound bus at a roadside stop with its door open and nobody stepping down
a young man on a bench drawing the open empty door of a bus

panels.composition: The bus gone. The bench. The dog asleep. The strip, for no one, of no one arriving.

image.prompt: an empty roadside bus stop in rain with a young man on the bench and a dog asleep under it, black and white, no words
image.notes: The last strip the book takes from Box 5. The next page is January 2004: online, six and a Sunday.

art.line: brush-pen, committed; xerox; black and white

notes: Nobody gets off. Nobody printed it. Box 5 closes here in the book.
